card.category: hosted bot (Telegram file to HTTP link)
card.summary: Free to use, no account: 'This bot generate direct download link of Telegram Files.' No quota, rate limit or file-size cap appears on the bot's page.

record.category: hosted bot (Telegram file to HTTP link)

free_tier.stated: Free to use, no account: 'This bot generate direct download link of Telegram Files.' No quota, rate limit or file-size cap appears on the bot's page.
free_tier.notes: the absence is not a measurement of capacity

per_object_cap.stated: Not published. The only documented ceiling is Telegram's 2 GB per object.

retention.stated: The file stays in the chat it was posted in; the bot's link lifetime is not stated on its page.

egress.terms: Free, and the point of the bot: it hands back an HTTP link, which sidesteps the Bot API's 20 MB getFile ceiling by streaming through the vendor's own Telegram session.
egress.price_per_tb: the mechanism is inferred from what the bot does, not from a statement about its account

record.interface_detail: A Telegram chat: send or forward a file, receive a URL.
record.tooling: Any Telegram client; the returned URL works in a browser, VLC or a download manager with range requests.
record.chaining: The cheapest way past the 20 MB getFile wall without running a server: a file already in Telegram becomes a plain HTTP URL, so a script never touches the Bot API's download path.

limits.value: 2 GB, Telegram's own object ceiling; the bot states none

record.binding_note: Nothing else is published. At 1 TiB/month the object ceiling is reachable and the vendor's own throttling is unknown, so the honest binding is the documented one.

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account to message the bot; no token, key or email is requested.

record.reliability_note: A single-operator bot with no published capacity: its links can expire or disappear without notice, and nothing in the page says how long it keeps a session alive.
record.confidence_note: The bot exists and describes itself this way today. Its cap is `unverified`: no file was sent, so the record rests on the platform ceiling, not on the operator's policy.

evidence.proved: 'This bot generate direct download link of Telegram Files.' - page resolves with a Start action, no monthly-user count shown
'Use the getFile method. Please note that this will only work with files of up to 20 MB in size.' - the limit this class of bot exists to bypass

record.notes: Abandon if the page stops resolving or loses the description. Its value is structural (an MTProto-backed URL) rather than quantitative, so do not quote a quota for it until one is measured.
